title: 5 Recursive Loops That Make Self-Improvement Actually Stick
description:
Most self-improvement plateaus. Not because the habits are wrong — because single-layer improvement has a structural ceiling.

In this video, I break down 5 recursive loops that change how you improve, not just what you improve on.

[TIMESTAMPS_PLACEHOLDER]

These aren't motivational tactics. They're structural changes to how the improvement system works — covering your information diet, habit stacks, review systems, skill selection, and identity narrative. Each loop improves your capacity to run the next one.

The idea that connected all five for me: when your improvement process improves itself, you stop needing willpower to sustain it. The loops start feeding themselves. Most people never find this because they're optimizing at the wrong level.

If you've been doing the work and still feel like you're plateauing, this is probably why.
